<br>
The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 11: Wild Card Qualifier''' was the tournament held on March 9, 2021 to determine the seed for the [[2021 AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 11|AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 11]].
